UserProfile.description: User profile, onboarding data, career readiness, skills, roadmap, resume, and mock interview history.

phone.description: User phone number with country code

degree.description: Degree program (e.g. B.Tech, BCA, MCA, M.Tech)

branch.description: Academic branch / specialization (e.g. CSE, IT, AI/ML)

location.description: Preferred work location or mode (e.g. Remote, Bengaluru)

profileCompleted.description: Indicates whether the user has completed onboarding

resumeURL.description: Firebase Storage download URL for the user's uploaded resume (PDF or DOCX)

resumeFileName.description: Original file name of the uploaded resume

resumeStoragePath.description: Firebase Storage object path under resumes/{uid}/

resumeFileType.description: MIME type of the uploaded resume (e.g. application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

resumeFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the uploaded resume file (max 10MB)

resumeUploadedAt.description: Timestamp when the resume was uploaded to Firebase Storage

profile.description: Full user profile details and education

readiness.description: Skill gap analysis and score breakdown

roadmap.description: Personalized career roadmap steps and tasks

practiceHistory.description: AI mock interview records and evaluations

SkillGapAnalysis.description: User's AI skill gap analysis results comparing current skills and resume against target job role.

summary.description: Executive summary of readiness and key gap insights

scoreExplanation.description: Short explanation of why this readiness score was generated

strongSkills.description: Skills clearly demonstrated by user and resume

improvementSkills.description: Skills with partial evidence requiring deeper mastery

missingSkills.description: Important missing skills required for target role

learningRoadmap.description: Personalized stages to bridge skill gaps

projectRecommendations.description: Recommended projects targeting primary skill gaps

resumeUsed.description: Metadata of the resume used in this analysis

JobRecommendations.description: Personalized AI job recommendations and dynamic match scores for the user

targetRole.description: Target role for which jobs were recommended

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when recommendations were generated

isDemo.description: Flag indicating if recommendations use demo fallback data or real API

jobs.description: List of recommended job objects with match scores, matching skills, missing skills, and improvement tips

jobId.description: Unique identifier of the saved job

applyUrl.description: External application URL or demo marker

isDemo.description: Whether this is a demo listing or real job

savedAt.description: Timestamp when the job was bookmarked

GeneratedResume.description: Phase 5 AI-generated ATS resumes created and managed by the candidate

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the candidate owner

title.description: Custom user title (e.g. Software Developer Resume)

targetRole.description: Target job title for ATS alignment

personalInfo.description: Full name, contact email, phone, location, links

skills.description: List of validated technical and domain skills

projects.description: Portfolio projects with bullet points, tech stack, and links

experience.description: Work experiences or internships with impact bullets

atsFeedback.description: ATS strengths, suggestions, and missing keywords

tailoredForJob.description: Metadata if customized for a specific opportunity

InterviewSession.description: Phase 6 AI interview sessions, questions, evaluations, and comprehensive performance reports

interviewType.description: Type: mock, technical, behavioral, resume, job_specific, skill_gap

targetRole.description: Target job title for the interview

jobId.description: Optional ID of the target job if job-specific interview

jobTitle.description: Optional title of target company job

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in this session

recommendations.description: Recommended study topics and action steps

questions.description: List of question records with user answers, evaluations, and scores

CareerAssistantSession.description: Personalized career assistant conversation history, containing messages, recommendations, and context memory.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner

messages.description: Array of chat messages containing id, role (user or assistant), content, timestamp, recommendations, nextSteps, and relatedFeatures

CareerRoadmap.description: Active AI Career Roadmap and personal progress tracking record with stages, tasks, milestones, and achievements.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the candidate owner

targetRole.description: Target job title for the roadmap

duration.description: Timeline duration (e.g. 2 Weeks, 1 Month, 3 Months, 6 Months, Custom)

completedTasksCount.description: Number of completed tasks across all stages

totalTasksCount.description: Total number of tasks across all stages

stages.description: Ordered stages containing individual career tasks with status, priority, and reasons

achievements.description: Lightweight achievements unlocked by user actions

skillProgressList.description: Skills with progress percentages and target mastery levels

projectRecommendations.description: Practical hands-on projects tailored to the target role

CareerRoadmapHistory.description: Historical snapshots of regenerated career roadmaps.

roadmapId.description: Identifier of the archived roadmap snapshot

targetRole.description: Target role at time of archive

overallProgress.description: Progress score at time of archive

completedTasksCount.description: Completed tasks count at time of archive

totalTasksCount.description: Total tasks count at time of archive

stagesSummary.description: Summary of stages and progress scores

CareerAnalytics.description: Consolidated career analytics, readiness score breakdown, skill trends, job match data, interview performance, and AI-driven career insights.

targetRole.description: Target role at time of analytics calculation

skills.description: Aggregated skills, improving skills, and priority gaps

jobs.description: Job match averages, best match, and top missing skills

resume.description: Resume ATS score, versions, and improvement areas

interview.description: Interview session averages, best scores, and trends

roadmap.description: Roadmap task progress, velocity, and stages

insights.description: AI-generated strengths, risks, weekly insight, and next best action

activities.description: List of recent authenticated user career actions

CareerAnalyticsHistory.description: Historical snapshots of career analytics scores for progress tracking over time.

snapshotId.description: Identifier of the historical analytics snapshot

overallReadiness.description: Overall career readiness score at time of capture

targetRole.description: Target role at time of snapshot

snapshot.description: Partial or full analytics snapshot JSON

JobApplication.description: User tracked job applications, status timeline, notes, contact, dates, and AI guidance.

jobUrl.description: Link to the external job posting or application portal

workMode.description: Work style: Remote, Hybrid, or Onsite

status.description: Current stage in the application pipeline (Saved, Applied, Screening, Assessment, Interview, Final Interview, Offer, Accepted, Rejected, Withdrawn)

applicationDate.description: Date application was submitted or recorded (ISO format)

followUpDate.description: Target date for recruiter/hiring manager follow-up

matchingSkills.description: List of user skills matching the job requirements

missingSkills.description: List of missing skills for the job

resumeId.description: ID of resume used for this application

resumeFileName.description: File or template name of the resume used

contact.description: Recruiter or hiring manager contact details

priority.description: Application priority level: High, Medium, or Low

statusHistory.description: Complete chronological status change audit trail with timestamps and notes

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when record was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when record was last updated

PortfolioProject.description: User portfolio project records with detailed problem, stack, role, outcomes, URLs, and AI optimizations.

imageUrls.description: Project screenshots or demo preview images

featured.description: Whether project is highlighted on the portfolio hero/showcase

targetRoles.description: Target job roles this project supports

aiAnalysis.description: AI analysis with resume bullets, portfolio narrative, interview STAR answers

PortfolioSettings.description: User portfolio configuration, chosen template, personal headline, bio, and publishing state.

isPublic.description: Whether public portfolio link is active

featuredProjectIds.description: IDs of projects displayed in featured section

GitHubAnalysis.description: Cached public GitHub profile analysis, analyzed public repositories, metrics, and quality indicators.

repositories.description: List of authentic public repository metadata

analysisSummary.description: Aggregated repository quality, languages, and recommendations

PublicPortfolio.description: Sanitized, published portfolio viewable publicly without exposing private candidate data.

profile.description: Sanitized public profile info (name, headline, bio, college, links)
